description: This file defines a React component for the Applicant Portal interface of a Business Loan application platform. It manages draft applications, document uploads, and submission logic, integrating various API calls and rendering UI components such as headers, sidebars, panels, and toast notifications.

methods.name: prettyJson
methods.description: Formats a JavaScript object or JSON string into a pretty-printed JSON string with indentation.

methods.name: safeJsonStr
methods.description: Tries to parse a JSON string and then serialize it again; if input is not a valid JSON string, converts it to string.

methods.name: shortId
methods.description: Returns last 6 characters of an ID in uppercase, or a placeholder if ID is absent.

methods.name: statusTheme
methods.description: Returns style theme (background, color, dot color) based on application status string.

methods.name: addToast
methods.description: Creates a toast notification with a message and type, auto-removing after 4.5 seconds.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes an async function with busy state management, shows success or error toasts based on result.

methods.name: fetchDrafts
methods.description: Fetches list of all application drafts from API and updates state.

methods.name: fetchDocs
methods.description: Fetches documents linked to a specific draft ID and updates state.

methods.name: doCreateDraft
methods.description: Creates a new draft application with default sections and selects it.

methods.name: doPatchSection
methods.description: Saves the current section data and status to the selected draft via API.

methods.name: doUpload
methods.description: Uploads a selected file as a document linked to the current draft.

methods.name: doCheckReadiness
methods.description: Checks if the current draft meets required sections and documents for submission.

methods.name: doSubmit
methods.description: Submits the draft application after passing readiness checks.

methods.name: doDecide
methods.description: Performs a draft decisioning action, such as approval or rejection.

methods.name: doDeleteDoc
methods.description: Removes an uploaded document by ID from the draft.

methods.name: doLogout
methods.description: Logs out the user, clears tokens, and redirects to login page.
